full_judgment: 25. Rule 44 of the Tenancy Rules, 1955 provides that under chapter XVII of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, Director of land records and surveys has been vested with the power to discharge all the functions of a revenue officer who shall have the powers of a settlement officer under Rules 36, 38, 39, 40, 41 and 42B of the Tenancy Rules, 1955 including a power of direction under Rule 42A of the Tenancy Rules, 1955 to correct any entry that has been procured by fraud in the records-of-rights before final publication of the same.
